sourceHtml: Sponsored by: Teleport — AI agents (and sub-agents they spawn) are given the same access as humans, but they never sleep. Learn how to monitor and constrain their behavior with isolated ephemeral trusted runtimes.

translation.html: 赞助方： Teleport — AI 智能体（以及它们生成的子智能体）被授予与人类相同的访问权限，但它们从不休眠。了解如何利用隔离的临时可信运行时来监控和约束它们的行为。
